subject: Close Bridge MAP: phased canary cohort -> full migration execution
messages:
From: Samira Gupta <samira@clearmind.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Todd Reynolds <todd.reynolds@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Agreement signed — next steps for rollout and evaluation

Logan, thanks — excited to be moving forward. Todd and I chatted and we want a single consolidated plan that ties the legal signature to the practical steps our engineering and ML teams will run. Specifically: a short canary with 10% traffic, an evaluation plan that checks latency and hallucination regressions against our baseline, and a training cadence for 2 waves of customer ops. Can you send a clear execution plan with owners and dates?

Also, two constraints from our side: (1) all test data must stay in our VPC during the pilot, and (2) we need KMS integration completed before any PII is sent.

—Samira
Principal Product Manager
ClearMind Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samira Gupta <samira@clearmind.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Todd Reynolds <todd.reynolds@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Agreement signed — next steps for rollout and evaluation

Samira — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a concise execution manifest (MAP_CloseBridge_v1.xlsx) and an evaluation checklist (eval_checklist_v1.pdf). High level summary embedded below so your team has a quick reference.

Plan summary (phased):
1) Incubation / Canary cohort (Week 0–2):
   - Scope: 2 endpoints, 10% traffic routed to Redwood Dedicated instances in your EU/US region mix; no PII until KMS is validated.
   - Owners: Redwood - Ben Carter (Solutions), Marissa Cole (Success). ClearMind - Todd (Eng), Samira (PM).
   - Success criteria: token latency p50 < 280ms, end-to-end throughput 120 TPS sustained, zero critical hallucination alerts on the evaluation prompt set (see checklist).
2) Expansion wave (Week 3–5):
   - Broaden to 40% traffic, enable prefix caching for common templates, run retraining of reranker if variance > 3% in intent F1.
3) Full migration (Week 6–8):
   - Switch production routing, ramp to 100% with rollback gates every 24 hours for first 7 days.

Training & ops: two training waves — Wave A (customer ops + triage) during Week 2; Wave B (developer integration + runbook handoff) Week 4. We included session owners in the spreadsheet.

Prereqs we will coordinate on: API keys, VPC peering setup, KMS token exchange, and a brief SOC2 evidence handoff. I flagged the KMS task as blocking — we won't enable PII flows until that's green.

I'll set a short kickoff for Wednesday to walk the MAP and agree owners. If acceptable, Marissa will post the shared schedule in the Drive link and create the runbook page for the canary (canary_runbook.md).

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Gupta <samira@clearmind.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Todd Reynolds <todd.reynolds@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Agreement signed — next steps for rollout and evaluation

Adding a few operational notes from the success team:

- Canary cohort testing will include a dry-run window (48 hours) where we mirror traffic without persisting outputs. That satisfies your VPC constraint while giving us load characteristics.
- Eval harness: we will push the baseline prompt set (50 prompts) and the adversarial list (15 prompts) to your test cluster; results will be posted to the shared Drive.
- Training sessions: we recommend 90-minute interactive sessions with a 30-minute follow-up Q&A; we'll record and share.

Marissa (cc'ed) — can you confirm dates for Wave A and Wave B by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Gupta <samira@clearmind.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Todd Reynolds <todd.reynolds@healthgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jun 2027 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Agreement signed — next steps for rollout and evaluation

Thanks Marissa — that dry-run mirror approach looks good. For the evaluation: would you additionally capture per-prompt token-cost delta and model-safety incidents (if any) so we can include cost/quality in the post-run review?

Wave A dates: Jun 15 (90-min ops session). Wave B dates: Jun 29 (developer deep-dive). Those work for the ClearMind team. Todd and I will be on the kickoff.

Samira

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Gupta <samira@clearmind.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Agreement signed — next steps for rollout and evaluation

Looping in a short technical checklist and noting a couple of follow-ups: 

- KMS test vectors: we'll send an envelope example and a quick test harness this afternoon.
- VPC peering: Redwood infra will open a ticket with your network team; please expect a short runbook with iptables and routes.
- Canary telemetry: we'll surface a per-prompt cost delta, p50/p95 latency, hallucination flag rate, and an SBAR-style summary after the 48h mirror and after the 2-week canary.

Attaching the canary runbook and eval checklist to this thread and to the Drive folder. See you all on the kickoff.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
